
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; color: rgba(92, 97, 102, 1); background-color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; padding: 1.5em 1em"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">日常数据处理中，经常遇到需要把一批 CSV 文件汇总到一个 Excel 工作簿的场景——每个 CSV 对应一个工作表，方便统一查看和分发。Python 原生 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">csv</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 模块可以读取数据，但要逐个写入 Excel 的不同工作表，还需要额外的写入逻辑。使用 Free Spire.XLS for Python 免费库可以直接将 CSV 加载为工作簿对象，再将其工作表复制到目标工作簿中，代码量很少。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">环境准备</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">通过 pip 安装免费版本即可，支持 Python 3.6+ 以及 Windows、macOS、Linux：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-bash" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">pip install Spire.Xls.Free
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.XLS for Python 无需安装 Microsoft Excel，在服务器或无桌面环境中也能运行。需要注意，免费版对 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">.xls</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 格式的读写有工作表数量限制（每个工作簿最多 5 个，每个工作表最多 200 行）；如果输出为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">.xlsx</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 格式，则不触发这一限制。对于工作表数量较多或行数较大的场景，建议输出 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">.xlsx</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">核心思路</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">单个 CSV 文件用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Workbook.LoadFromFile()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 加载后，数据会出现在工作簿的第一个工作表（索引 0）中。要合并多个 CSV，可以：</span></p>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">创建一个目标 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Workbook</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">；</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">遍历 CSV 文件列表，每个文件单独加载；</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Worksheets.AddCopy()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 将其工作表复制到目标工作簿；</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">重命名复制过来的工作表，便于区分；</span></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">保存目标工作簿为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">.xlsx</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。</span></li>
</ol>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AddCopy</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 方法会连同数据、格式一并复制，第二个参数 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">WorksheetCopyType.CopyAll</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 可确保完整性。</span></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">完整代码</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">以下脚本将指定目录下所有 CSV 文件合并到一个 Excel 文件中，每个 CSV 对应一个工作表：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> os
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> glob
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">from</span> spire.xls.common <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">import</span> *
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">def</span> <span class="hljs-title function_" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">merge_csv_to_excel</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">csv_dir, output_path, delimiter=<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">","</span></span>):<br>
<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"""<br>
将目录下的所有 CSV 文件合并到一个 Excel 文件中。<br>
每个 CSV 对应一个工作表，工作表名取自文件名（不含扩展名）。</span></p>
<p>参数:<br>
csv_dir: CSV 文件所在目录<br>
output_path: 输出 Excel 文件路径（建议 .xlsx）<br>
delimiter: CSV 分隔符，默认逗号<br>
"""<br>
csv_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(csv_dir, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"*.csv"</span>))<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">not</span> csv_files:<br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">print</span>(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"未找到 CSV 文件"</span>)<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">return</span></p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 创建目标工作簿</span><br>
target_book = Workbook()</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 删除默认生成的空白工作表（保留一个作为占位，后续按需删除）</span><br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 这里先不删，处理完第一个文件后再统一处理</span></p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> idx, file_path <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">enumerate</span>(csv_files):<br>
file_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(file_path))[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 加载单个 CSV 文件</span><br>
source_book = Workbook()<br>
source_book.LoadFromFile(file_path, delimiter, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 获取 CSV 解析后的工作表</span><br>
source_sheet = source_book.Worksheets[<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>]</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 复制到目标工作簿</span><br>
target_book.Worksheets.AddCopy(source_sheet, WorksheetCopyType.CopyAll)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 重命名新复制的工作表</span><br>
new_sheet = target_book.Worksheets[target_book.Worksheets.Count - <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>]<br>
new_sheet.Name = file_name[:<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">31</span>]  <span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># Excel 工作表名最长 31 个字符</span></p>
<p>source_book.Dispose()</p>
<p><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">print</span>(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"已导入: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{file_name}</span>"</span>)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 删除目标工作簿中最初的空白工作表</span><br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 默认 Workbook() 会创建 3 个工作表，删除未使用的</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">for</span> i <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">range</span>(target_book.Worksheets.Count - <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, -<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>, -<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1</span>):<br>
sheet = target_book.Worksheets[i]<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 如果工作表名仍是默认的 Sheet1/Sheet2/Sheet3，且不在已导入的列表中</span><br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> sheet.Name <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> [<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"Sheet1"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"Sheet2"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"Sheet3"</span>]:<br>
target_book.Worksheets.RemoveAt(i)</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"># 保存为 xlsx</span><br>
target_book.SaveToFile(output_path, FileFormat.Version2016)<br>
target_book.Dispose()<br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">print</span>(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">f"\n合并完成: <span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{output_path}</span>"</span>)</p>
</code><p><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">if</span> <strong>name</strong> == <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"<strong>main</strong>"</span>:<br>
merge_csv_to_excel(<br>
csv_dir=<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"./csv_files"</span>,<br>
output_path=<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"./merged_output.xlsx"</span>,<br>
delimiter=<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">","</span><br>
)<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0.3em 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.35em; color: rgba(252, 252, 252, 1); background-color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">几个关键点</span></h2>
<ol style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">LoadFromFile 的参数</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。
</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">LoadFromFile(fileName, separator, startRow, startColumn)</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 中，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">separator</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 指定分隔符，不限于逗号。如果处理的是制表符分隔的 TSV，传入 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">"\t"</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 即可；分号分隔的欧洲数据文件传入 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">";"</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">工作表命名</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。
Excel 工作表名最长 31 个字符，且不能包含 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">\ / ? * [ ] :</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 等字符。上面的代码用 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">file_name[:31]</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 做了截断，如果实际文件名中包含特殊字符，建议再做一次替换处理。</span></p>
</li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">删除默认工作表</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。
</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Workbook()</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 初始化时会自动创建 3 个空白工作表。上面的代码在导入完成后遍历删除名称为 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Sheet1/Sheet2/Sheet3</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 的工作表，但要注意如果 CSV 文件名恰好也叫 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">Sheet1.csv</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，会产生误删。更稳妥的做法是在创建目标工作簿后立即清空默认工作表：</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1em 0; padding: 1.2em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); border-radius: 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6"><code class="language-python" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: inherit; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875em; line-height: 1.5">target_book = Workbook()
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">while</span> target_book.Worksheets.Count &gt; <span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>:
    target_book.Worksheets.RemoveAt(<span class="hljs-number" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">0</span>)
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">这样 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AddCopy</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 添加的工作表从第一个开始，逻辑更干净。但需要注意，如果删除所有工作表后直接 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">AddCopy</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，部分版本可能报错，此时可以先保留一个再替换。根据实际库版本调整即可。</span></p>
<ol start="4" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 1em; padding-left: 2em; list-style-type: decimal">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0 0 0.4em; line-height: 1.7"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1)">非 UTF-8 编码的 CSV</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">。
如果 CSV 文件使用 GBK 等编码，</span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">LoadFromFile</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 可能无法正确解析中文。这种情况下可以先用 Python 的 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, &quot;Liberation Mono&quot;, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; background-color: rgba(248, 249, 250, 1); color: rgba(242, 151, 24, 1); padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 3px; word-break: break-all">csv</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 模块读取并转码为临时文件，再交给 Spire.XLS 加载，或者确认该库当前版本是否支持通过参数指定编码。</span></li>
</ol>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 1.5em 0; border-top: 2px solid rgba(230, 232, 235, 1); border-right: none; border-bottom: none; border-left: none; border-radius: 2px">
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.8"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">这个脚本适合轻量自动化场景，把零散 CSV 归集到一个 Excel 工作簿，每个文件单独一个 sheet。Free Spire.XLS for Python 的优势在于脱离 Office 环境运行，CSV 导入 API 封装简洁，不需要手动逐行读写单元格。</span></p></section>

</div>
